text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's a fan letter.
Though the person who sent it is a bit unusual.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, he's a monk in training.
He said he felt something profound
from the way I ran...

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
—Dear Sir/Madam—
Though I normally try to keep secular matters at arm's length as much as possible—

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
"I happened to see your running and was deeply moved,
so I am writing you this letter."

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
Immerse myself deeply within the run,
simply enduring and persevering until the moment of victory arrives...

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
It must be painful. Suffocating, even.
Yet, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
Salvation and liberation lie only beyond that point.
That is what you so firmly believe.

text_block_list.name: Chief Priest
text_block_list.text:
"No heat lasts forever.
In time, for both you and me—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could I borrow a writing brush?
I would like to write a reply.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And what Believe wrote next was...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It is finished.
Pouring all my feelings into a single character.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I believe this alone
is enough to convey my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"This period of patient endurance will likely continue
for a little while longer. But—one day, surely."
